entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dnx` crashes with on Alpine/musl because direct dotnet.dll invocation lacks HOSTFXR_PATH #55238
  • Update getting started doc for `dotnetup` to include daily support #55236
  • [watch aspire] Error reported on cancellation via Ctrl+C #55229

Closed

  • Consider changing MSTest parallelization from MethodLevel to ClassLevel #54956
  • Add 10.0 branches to Get-BranchMirrorStatus.ps1 and plan removal after 8.x/9.x EOL #55120
  • Updates to `builds-table.md` #55239

PullRequests

Created

  • [Experiment] Agentic Triage Workflow #55244
  • [Experiment] Create a .NET SDK Issue Monster #55243
  • Stop shipping dnx from the SDK component on macOS #55241
  • Reorganize compatibility test projects under test/Compatibility #55240
  • Document dotnetup daily channels in getting started guide #55237
  • Render assertion expected/actual diff for multi-assembly dotnet test (pipe protocol fields 10/11) #55235
  • Fix VMR sync: update aspire remote name #55234
    Servicing-consider
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #55233
  • Enable MSBuild server by default in MSBuildForwardingApp #55231
  • Bump minimum MSBuild version to 18.7 #55230

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55228
  • [watch aspire] Suppress OperationCanceledException in StartChannelReader on shutdown #55242
  • [watch] Static web asset abstraction #55188
  • [watch] Refactor CompilationHandler #55172
  • [watch] Avoid updating running processes state in GetManagedCodeUpdatesAsync #55160
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #55158
  • Add 7-day grace period for new Known Build Error issues #55232
  • Work around license scan timeout by scanning source-build-assets serially #55219
    Servicing-consider
  • Forward Azure DevOps log commands and host display messages to dotnet test (protocol 1.2.0/1.3.0) #55221

Updated

  • Enable NativeAOT CLI command handling by default (DOTNET_CLI_ENABLEAOT) #55144
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, 11.0.1xx
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.3.0-preview.26325.12 to 4.3.0 #55213
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Update GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles task to generate Hot Reload runtime options #53715
  • Re-enable C++/CLI test coverage previously gated on VS 2026 toolset availability #54558
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
    breaking-change
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55161
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55202
  • Dotnetup: add `env` command to update PathPreference mode #54545
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55175
  • Reliable CLI telemetry via a persist-then-drain OpenTelemetry exporter #55211
  • Enable MSBuildTask0004 task-authoring analyzer at error severity #55060
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-NetSDK
  • Enable MSBuildTask0001 task-authoring analyzer at error severity #55053
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-NetSDK
  • Enable same-OS cross-arch NativeAOT builds; cross-build arm64 AoT legs on x64 #55205
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-dotnet AOT
  • Update VersionFeature80 and VersionFeature90 calculations for the August release #55222
  • Fix missing indentation in API diff for first member after synthesized constructor #54130
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix `dotnet sln` failing to parse `.slnf` files with unescaped backslashes in path #54622
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
  • Fix composite ReadyToRun publish when RelativePath has a path component #55200
    Area-ReadyToRun
